condition_spec.name: haiku-explore
condition_spec.note: Baseline plus one file: `.claude/agents/Explore.md` declaring `model: haiku`, which overrides Claude Code's built-in `Explore` subagent (project agents outrank built-ins) so delegated exploration runs on Haiku while the main session stays on Sonnet. Its `CLAUDE.md` is byte-identical to baseline's — the arm changes who explores, not what the agent is told.

argv:
Users are getting notified about their own actions: comment on an issue you are assigned to and you immediately receive a notification telling you that a comment was added. It should go to the other watchers and not to you. Find the cause and fix it.

This is a `fix` task: edit the code and stop. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
